Question:
Has the Company developed and published a
Board Charter which is periodically reviewed
and which sets out the Board responsibility for
internal control?

Does the Board Charter or Company
documents distinguish the responsibilities
of the Board from management in line with
Code requirements?

Is there a statement indicating the
responsibility of Board members for the
application of corporate governance policies
and procedures of the Company?

Has the Board ensured all directors,
CEOs and management are fully aware of
the requirements of the Kenyan CG Code?
